title: Human Intelligence Platform Strategic Readiness and Gap Contract
purpose: Preserve the medium- and long-term strategic platform thesis while recording the work required to convert the architecture into a fundable and NVIDIA Inception-ready early-stage startup.

strategic_positioning.thesis: A Human-in-the-Loop Digital Twin platform with reusable infrastructure for identity, consent, events, evidence, capabilities, relationships, permissioned agents and human decisions.
commercial_sequence: B2C beachhead: one Personal Twin decision
B2B: authorized relationships between people, organizations and twins
strategic_positioning.capex_boundary_note: CapEx is used as a strategic investment framing for reusable technology assets; accounting and tax treatment requires separate professional confirmation.

known_public_criteria: clear company, product, mission and differentiation
evaluation_basis.disclaimer: Internal decision aid, not an NVIDIA score or promise.

status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Concept exists but needs implementation or evidence.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKING: Must close before applying or claiming the related maturity.

operating_rules: Do not present proposed architecture as implemented product.
Do not expand to all seven personal domains before validating one.
Every feature maps to a platform layer, decision, evidence source and maturity gate.
Every NVIDIA claim is labeled implemented, candidate or to validate.
Execute the earliest unresolved BLOCKING item first.
